description: This file contains the source code for the Opencart System Library Cache Memcached class. It defines a class that provides methods for interacting with Memcached caching, including methods for constructing the cache object, getting, setting, and deleting cache entries, and constants related to cache limits.

classes.name: Opencart\System\Library\Cache\Memcached
classes.description: A class that implements caching functionality using Memcached, including methods to initialize the cache, retrieve values by key, store values, and delete entries.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method to initialize the Memcached cache with an optional expiration time.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached value by its key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in the cache with a specified key and expiration time.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a cached entry identified by its key.
